The strongest setups are repeat offenders with renewed perp discounts, rather than fresh listings. I’m ranking by expected funding depth as well as hit probability: ENSO and KAT retain substantial tail potential despite modest current pressure, while PHA and GUN show clearer near-term pressure.

Probabilities are anchored to the historical quiet-coin rates, with adjustments for current evidence—not treated as independent signal multipliers. Spot-pair removal notices are only supporting evidence; they do not establish that all spot trading or borrowing is unavailable.

Previous episodes paid 11.64% over 3.8 days and 12.67% over 13.5 days, but premium -0.0252%, declining OI and confirmed margin availability warrant a restrained hit probability despite substantial conditional depth.

Premium is -0.2292%, predicted funding dipped to -0.5580% and the settled weekly minimum is still just above threshold at -0.0986%; partial intraday cooling and the three-day execution lag temper the forecast.

After a 77.81% sixty-day advance, price fell 14.34% in three days, with predicted funding averaging -0.0396% over 24h and repeated hourly-bucket lows around -0.21% to -0.25%. Premium is -0.1974%, spot turnover $0.722M and the last deep episode ended 17 days ago; a prior 8.2-day episode paid 4.37%, supporting more than a shallow touch.

26 deep days and a 31-day cooldown accompany a 28.71% sixty-day decline, while the latest 12h premium deteriorated to -0.158% and predicted funding reached -0.0764% with a -0.1287% intraday low. Spot volume is $0.581M, and prior episodes include a -3.953% print in April and multi-day deep runs; absent OI confirmation and modest current activity limit probability.

Supply increased 18.11% in 30 days as price fell 25.16%, with OI still 17.53% of market cap and only $0.545M daily spot volume. Settled funding approached threshold at -0.0937%, premium averages -0.2215% and Bybit's seven-day mean is -0.0204%; the prior 6.7-day episode paid 4.20%, although declining OI and a recovered latest prediction are counterweights.

39 deep days, a 29-day cooldown and historical multi-week episodes support sustained relapse potential; current perp turnover is 8.99x spot, with spot volume only $0.625M. Premium is -0.1427%, Binance prediction -0.0387% and Hyperliquid funding -0.0345%; recent spot-pair removals add a liquidity caution, but falling OI prevents a stronger forecast.

Hourly predicted lows worsened from roughly -0.04% to -0.19%, with current prediction -0.0865%, premium -0.2021% and predicted trend -0.0188 percentage points. A $22.43M market cap, $0.404M spot turnover and 12 deep days support relapse susceptibility; April's one-day episode paid 1.88% with a -2.50% trough, demonstrating meaningful conditional depth.

The May pump has retraced to 47.15% below the monthly high, while OI remains 19.64% of an $8.87M market cap and perp/spot turnover is 7.28x. Premium flipped from positive hourly buckets to negative, current premium is -0.5784% and predicted trend -0.0771 percentage points; monitoring status and the recent -1.293% episode support depth, but recurring false predicted dips and OI contraction constrain probability.

46 deep days and a prior 40.8-day episode paying 72.35% give substantial tail potential after a 29-day cooldown; price is still up 57.34% monthly but down 6.39% weekly, with supply up 4.22%. Premium -0.1329% and an intraday prediction of -0.0717% show mild pressure, but $12.99M spot turnover and a 72h perp/spot ratio below 1 materially weaken the arbitrage-constraint case.

24 deep days and a 29-day cooldown combine with thin $0.169M spot turnover and a 6.78% three-day price decline. Premium widened from -0.096% in the first hourly bucket to about -0.255% over the latest day, predicted funding dipped to -0.1146% and its trend is -0.0106 percentage points; a prior 3.2-day episode paid 2.71%, though other venues are not confirming.

OI is 24.98% of a $6.12M market cap, with 13 deep days and only a 13-day cooldown; prior episodes include 7.8 days paying 5.12%. The latest 12h premium widened to -0.203% and predicted funding dipped to -0.1332%; spot-pair removals provide supporting liquidity context, but declining OI and a near-flat predicted trend limit conviction.

Price is down 30.76% monthly and 42.33% over sixty days, with 22 deep days and only $0.165M daily spot turnover versus 7.45x perp volume. Current premium is -0.3512%, predicted funding -0.0693% and Bybit funding -0.0655%; May spot-pair removals reinforce the thin-liquidity concern, but historical episodes generally delivered less depth than higher-ranked names.
